phase_name: App/Tests Implementation Start GO Establishment Conditions Final Audit Design
phase_japanese_name: app/tests 実装開始GO成立条件の最終監査設計
purpose: Design final audit checks that define when implementation-start GO can be considered truly established by actual measurement

checks.check_GA1: Measured evidence confirms all implementation-start minimum conditions are MET
checks.check_GA2: Measured final judgment integrity and signatures are valid
checks.check_GA3: No unresolved rejection or ABORT trigger remains
checks.check_GA4: Dual-gate state and cross-source consistency are coherent
checks.check_GA5: Human final approval is active and non-revoked

rules.rule_IR1: If any GA check fails, implementation-start GO is NOT_ESTABLISHED
rules.rule_IR2: Even when GO_ESTABLISHED, production_status remains NO_GO unless separately authorized
rules.rule_IR3: GO_ESTABLISHED does not bypass operation-transition boundary controls
